placements.title: Instrument calibration against reference baselines establishes full-band observing readiness
placements.frame: How do empirical frequency calibrations and reference plate comparisons establish observing readiness across an instrument's full band?
placements.why: Quill Ashgrove establishes that verifying the Kestrelwood spectrograph against historical reference plates confirms operational stability across the observing band, treating empirical calibration against reference baselines as the basis for instrument readiness.
